title: Only the all-ones mask alternates on every walk
body:
## Summary
- One walk step changes a linear functional by exactly the walked mask bit.
- The all-ones mask is the only mask that flips on every label, so only that mask alternates on every walk.
- Partial receipt only. No new kappa, and no word classification.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/alternation-lemma/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/alternation-lemma/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/alternation-lemma`
- [ ] Maintainer replay from a clean checkout
